task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Existence(door_open) is redundant because the task commands 'Open the door. Pick up the box' which is an order. A hard Existence(target_picked_up) and a hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already force door_open to happen. Remove Existence(door_open) to satisfy the compactness requirement; keep the other two clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task consists of two distinct commanded actions: 'Open the door' and 'Pick up the box in the other room.' The current clauses treat 'Open the door' only as a precedence constraint for 'Pick up the box.' Because 'Open the door' is an independent command, it requires its own hard Existence(door_open) clause. Adding this existence clause will correctly ensure that the machine requires the door to be opened as part of the completion criteria, rather than just as a prerequisite for the box.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box to be picked up; Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) ensures the door is opened first. Together, they force the door to be open before the box is picked up, which is the correct interpretation of the command sequence.
